user.title: Share your energy data with Kilowattlas
user.description:
Kilowattlas is a public map of home energy and an energy-sharing service. Choose which power sensors from your Energy dashboard to share; readings are sent as they are measured.

- Solar and battery are shown on the public map, at your installation's position and under the name you give it.
- Grid, home and device power are visible only to you, unless you make them public.
- Your home position is sent once; you confirm or change it on the website.
- On kilowattlas.com you can make each sensor public, private or stop it. Removing this integration stops everything.

data.share_all: Share all sensors in my Energy dashboard

data_description.share_all: Also shares sensors you add to the Energy dashboard later.
data_description.share: Only these are shared. Sensors you add later are not, until you tick them under Configure.

finish.title: Finish the setup
finish.description: Your link is approved. Select Submit to create your installation on Kilowattlas.

energy_missing.title: Set up the Energy dashboard
energy_missing.description: Kilowattlas shares the power sensors of your Energy dashboard, and none are set up yet. Add them under **Settings → Dashboards → Energy**, then check again, or enter the sensors here.

menu_options.user: I have set up the Energy dashboard, check again

manual.title: Enter your sensors
manual.description: The same power settings as the Energy dashboard; at least one sensor is needed. Solar and battery are shown on the public map; grid, home and devices only to you, unless you change it on kilowattlas.com.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: The power at your grid connection, as in the Energy dashboard's grid settings.

data_description.grid_mode: One sensor that is positive when you import from the grid; one sensor that is positive when you export (inverted); or two sensors, one for import and one for export.
data_description.grid_power: With two sensors: the power taken from the grid.
data_description.grid_power_to: Only with two sensors: the power returned to the grid.

solar.name: Solar
solar.description: The power your solar panels produce.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Your home battery, as in the Energy dashboard's battery settings.

data_description.battery_mode: One sensor that is positive when the battery discharges; one sensor that is positive when it charges (inverted); or two sensors, one for discharging and one for charging.
data_description.battery_power: With two sensors: the power out of the battery.
data_description.battery_power_to: Only with two sensors: the power into the battery.

home.name: Home
home.description: The power the whole home uses, as in the Energy dashboard's home settings.

data_description.home_power: Positive; measured at the main panel.

devices.name: Individual devices
devices.description: Devices you also track in the Energy dashboard, such as an EV charger or a heat pump.

data_description.device_power: One sensor per device; positive while it draws power.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-link Kilowattlas
reauth_confirm.description: Kilowattlas no longer accepts the link for this installation. Approve a new link on the website to continue sharing.

progress.wait_for_approval:
Waiting for your approval on kilowattlas.com. Open the page and sign in; your code is **{user_code}**:

{verification_uri}

error.cannot_finish: Kilowattlas could not be reached, so nothing is set up yet. Select Submit to try again.
error.invalid_power_config: With two sensors, choose both of them.
error.nothing_chosen: Choose what to share: everything, or at least one sensor.

abort.activation_refused: Kilowattlas could not create the installation you approved ({reason}). Nothing was set up, here or on kilowattlas.com. Start over and approve a new link.
abort.expired: The linking code expired before it was approved. Nothing was set up. Start over to get a new code.
abort.link_lost: The approved link ran out before the setup was finished. Nothing was set up, here or on kilowattlas.com. Start over and approve a new link.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The approved link belongs to a different installation than the one being re-linked.

channels.title: Choose what to share
channels.description: The power sensors in your Energy dashboard. Tick the ones to share. Each one can also be made public, private or stopped on kilowattlas.com.

no_channels.title: Kilowattlas has nothing to share
no_channels.description: No power sensor is set up in your Energy dashboard. Add the power fields under **Settings → Dashboards → Energy**, or enter the sensors in the Kilowattlas options.

confirm.title: Share from your Energy dashboard
confirm.description: Your Energy dashboard now has power sensors set up. Kilowattlas can share those instead of the sensors entered in its own options, so you keep one list in one place. Your channels and their history on kilowattlas.com stay as they are.
